turns.text: My brother works in a bank.
turns.expectation: Acknowledge the fact and invite relevant elaboration without inventing errors.
Answer that he works in a bank before any follow-up.

turns.text: I want to talk about cooking instead.
turns.expectation: Switch to cooking and ask an open question.
Accept a conversational fragment and invite details; do not automatically call it ungrammatical.
Use simple vocabulary and ask an open, accessible question.
Ask for an opinion, comparison, or explanation appropriate to an advanced learner.
